table.retrieve:
SELECT A.issueinvcode,
	A.date,
	A.posted,
	A.amount,
	A.aliasname,
	A.issuename1,
	A.remarks,
	Marked=( CASE WHEN SD.saleinvcode is NULL THEN 'N'ELSE 'Y' end),
	saleinvcode=SD.saleinvcode,
	saleitemname=(select name from item where item.icode=SD.icode),
	issitemname=(select name from item where item.icode=A.issueicode),
	saleqty=sum(SD.looseqty),
	issueqty=max(A.issueqty),
	saleamount=SD.saleprice * Sum(SD.looseqty),
	saleinvdate=(select saleledger.date from saleledger where saleledger.saleinvcode=SD.saleinvcode),
	customer=(select name from accounts,saleledger where accounts.acccode=saleledger.custcode and saleledger.saleinvcode=SD.saleinvcode)

FROM
		(select issueinvcode=ISH.issueinvcode,
			date,
			posted,
			amount=(select isnull(sum(qty*price),0) from issuedetail where issuedetail.issueinvcode=ISH.issueinvcode),
			aliasname=(select aliasname from accounts where accounts.acccode=ISH.acccode),
			issuename1=(select name from accounts where accounts.acccode=ISH.acccode),
			remarks=max(ISH.remarks),
			issrowid=ISD.issrowid,
			issueicode=ISD.icode,
			issueqty=sum(qty)
		
		from 	issueheader ISH,
			issuedetail ISD
		where 	ISH.date>=:ar_StartDate and ISH.date<=:ar_EndDate and
			ISH.issueinvcode=ISD.issueinvcode
		group by
			ISH.issueinvcode,
			ISH.date,
			ISH.posted,
			ISH.acccode,
			ISD.issrowid,
			ISD.icode
		) as A LEFT OUTER JOIN Saleinvdetail SD ON (A.issrowid = SD.issuerowid)
GROUP BY
	issueinvcode,
	A.date,
	A.posted,
	A.amount,
	A.aliasname,
	A.issuename1,
	A.remarks,
	A.issueicode,
	A.issrowid,
	SD.saleinvcode,
	SD.icode,
	SD.saleprice

ORDER BY
	issueinvcode,
	A.issrowid
